title: senml.c uses undeclared strnlen: same minimal-libc -Werror build break as wmae, different subsystem
description: Found by robustness review pass of project-LICHEN-worker6-wmae (P2 sibling of the coap strnlen break). lichen/subsys/lichen/senml/senml.c:43 - live call strnlen(str, max_len + 1) inside string_too_long (used by validate_name/validate_unit). Zephyr's minimal libc does not declare strnlen, so any build pulling senml.c breaks with implicit-function-declaration -Werror, same class as the coap files fixed in wmae/af780aefe1. senml.c is compiled by senml/CMakeLists.txt:9 (its own subsystem, so the coap-level helper pattern does not reach it). Fix: mirror the reviewed pattern in-place - static senml_bounded_len(s, max) memchr helper; the call site is strnlen(str, max_len + 1) so no-NUL must yield max_len + 1 (the string_too_long comparison then rejects). Verify: build whatever app/suite pulls senml.c on native_sim v4.1.0 (or host-compile the file standalone) - note the zcbor stub gap (0whw) may block some apps; senml.c itself includes only zephyr/senml headers? confirm its include set compiles standalone.
close_reason: string_too_long (senml.c) replaced: strnlen(str, max_len + 1) > max_len -> str != NULL && memchr(str, '\0', max_len + 1) == NULL. Semantically exact: NULL short-circuit preserved; NUL at index max_len -> both false; no NUL in the max_len+1 scan -> both true; read envelope identical (both scan at most max_len+1 bytes, stop at first NUL). Callers are the three validate_* wrappers with compile-time maxima (32/8/256); the strings are API-input C strings and the encode path independently uses zcbor_tstr_put_term with the same 256 bound - the bounded scan is the same envelope the old strnlen had; the CBOR decode path uses explicit-length spans and never feeds string_too_long. Verified on heft: tests/senml host suite (standalone, clang, -std=c23 -Werror -Wconversion + ASan/UBSan) builds - the -Werror implicit-declaration gate this bead targets is exercised directly - and 27/27 tests pass incl. the max-accepted/max+1-rejected boundary cases (main.c:244-291, 495-522). cppcheck N/A (host suite supersedes). 3x codereview (correctness/security/robustness, reviewer-model passes): PASS x3, no P0-P2 attributable to the change (one P4 informational: max_len==SIZE_MAX wrap divergence in the helper's general contract - unreachable with the constant call sites). Follow-up strnlen sites surfaced by review and filed: s704 (P2 - apps/gateway/src/config_cbor.c:254); coap_status.c:495,498 are covered by af780aefe1 on beads-worker-2 (merges cleanly, verified byte-identical parent).
